title: Door posters
subtitle: Print one A5 poster per apartment and stick it on the door.
qrAlt: QR code to check in to {name}
lineEn: Scan this QR with your phone camera to check in. It takes about 2 minutes.
lineMl: ചെക്ക്-ഇൻ ചെയ്യാൻ ഫോൺ ക്യാമറ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഈ QR സ്കാൻ ചെയ്യുക. ഏകദേശം 2 മിനിറ്റ് മതി.
lineHi: चेक-इन के लिए अपने फ़ोन कैमरे से यह QR स्कैन करें। इसमें लगभग 2 मिनट लगते हैं।
rotateBody: A new key is made straight away and the poster on the door stops working. Print the new poster and put it up right after.
rotated: New key ready. Print the new poster and replace the old one.
noKey: This apartment has no door key yet. Create one to print its poster.
emptyBody: Add an apartment first, then come back here to print its door poster.
loadError: We could not load the door keys. Reload the page to try again.
siteWarning: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is not set, so the QR points to {origin}. Set it to the live address before you print.
